summary: FST Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $10.4M in ordinary shares under a shelf registration. The company entered into a Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright, which will act as sales agent receiving a 3% commission. Sales will be made on Nasdaq at prevailing market prices. No specific deal terms such as price per share or premium are stated. This is a routine capital raising transaction, not a special situation.
